title: Approve homepage composition
question: Which composition should we build? Teletext theming is fixed; pick the layout.

options.label: Focal Board
options.thesis: Large phase board first; Active cards and Upcoming list below.
options.viewport: Status bar → monumental focal event with one CTA → horizontal Active → Upcoming rows.
options.risk: Strong first viewport; denser multi-event scanning waits for scroll.

options.label: Semester Split
options.thesis: Compact focal beside a live semester board; project mosaic under.
options.viewport: Ticker → two-column focal + table → mosaic strip of projects.
options.risk: Best for operators with many events; can feel denser on laptop.

options.label: Magazine Frame
options.thesis: Teletext page chrome framing a familiar content well and project strip.
options.viewport: Outer page frame → hero + project highlights → Upcoming list.
options.risk: Most themed; frame must stay secondary to usability.
